title: MegaStyle: Scalable Artistic Style Curation Pipeline
summary: An automated data curation framework and 1.4M image dataset for precise artistic style transfer in diffusion models. It leverages vision-language models to decouple style from content, enabling consistent style library generation.
research_notes: Published under ArXiv:2604.08364; utilizes Qwen-Image for consistent style mapping and supports automated style-content decoupling.

evolution.summary: Initially released in April 2026, the project quickly scaled to a 1.4 million image dataset with official ComfyUI workflows. It now serves as a foundational style curation tool for Tencent's Hunyuan and FLUX model ecosystems.
